name: PCBWay
notes: Standard service 1-14 layers (Advanced PCB above). Standard price assumes >= 6/6 mil track/space and >= 0.3 mm holes; finer values (down to 4/4 mil, 0.15 mm drill) are charged extra. The two capabilities pages disagree on the hole-size price threshold (desktop < 0.2 mm, mobile < 0.3 mm). 'Normal process' columns of the Advanced PCB table are used for standard profiles, 'Medium difficulty' for the extra-cost profiles. Values are before compensation.

value_notes.track_width: Capabilities page: 'Min manufacturable trace is 4mil(0.1mm)'; mobile page and help center: 'strongly suggest to design trace above 6mil(0.15mm) to save cost'. Standard price = 6/6 mil (0.152 mm).
value_notes.via_drill: Desktop page: 'Min drill size is 0.15mm ... smaller than 0.2mm will be subject to extra charges'; mobile page: 'smaller than 0.3mm will be subject to extra charges'. 0.3 kept as the safe standard-price value.
value_notes.via_annular_ring: 'Min Width of Annular Ring 0.15mm(6mil). For pads with vias in the middle'. Advanced table (1 oz/35 um outer, via hole): normal >= 5 mil, medium >= 4 mil.
value_notes.pth_annular_ring: Main page 0.15 mm (6 mil). Advanced table (35 um outer, component hole): normal >= 10 mil (0.254), medium >= 8 mil (0.203).
value_notes.hole_to_hole: Help center: different nets 'min 0.30 mm for via spacing', '0.45 mm for plated through hole spacing'. Advanced table: via (<=0.45 mm) >= 11 mil, component hole >= 16 mil. Value is the via figure.
value_notes.hole_to_copper: Help center: 'min 0.2 mm from non-plated hole to trace, and min 0.35 mm from plated hole to trace'. Value = plated figure.
value_notes.edge_clearance: Advanced table 'Line to board edge distance, CNC milling': normal 0.25 mm, medium 0.20 mm. Help center: any hole to outline >= 0.5 mm (1.0 mm for V-score).
value_notes.npth_drill: Not published separately (general drill range 0.15/0.2-6.0 mm).
value_notes.max_drill: Desktop page 6.0 mm (mobile page 6.3 mm); larger holes extra / milled.
value_notes.silk_to_pad: Not published on the capabilities pages.
value_notes.mask_bridge: Advanced table, green mask, < 2 oz: normal 4 mil ('spacing between ICs is 8 mil'), black/variegated >= 4.5 mil (0.114).
value_notes.mask_expansion: Advanced table 'green solder mask opening >= 2 mil' (normal), 1.5 mil medium.
value_notes.castellated_hole: Advanced table: >= 0.5 mm normal (0.4 mm medium); main page min 0.4 mm. Spacing edge-to-edge >= 0.3 mm.
value_notes.smd_pad_to_pad: Not published as such; mask bridge row implies 8 mil (0.203 mm) IC pad spacing to keep a green mask dam.
